metadata.input: A clean technical infographic of a media processing pipeline on a dark navy background. Seven numbered stages flow top to bottom connected by arrows. Stage 1 Download with a cloud icon, Stage 2 Extract splitting into speech-to-text and OCR paths, Stage 3 Write as a large central AI brain node, then four output arrows fan out to Stage 4 TTS with a speaker icon, Stage 5 Image with a paintbrush, Stage 6 Video with a film reel, Stage 7 Music with a note. Teal for inputs, gold for the AI stage, coral and purple for outputs. Flat design, geometric shapes, minimal text, monospace labels, developer documentation style.
